title: The no-customer hint goes away once a customer is flagged
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure no customer of the organization carries the Internal customer flag.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings > Work Orders.
  2. Click Edit Customer on customer A's page.
  3. Tick the "Internal customer" checkbox.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Open Settings > Work Orders.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The first hint reads "No internal customer yet. Work orders for your own equipment stay billable until you flag one: Edit Customer > Internal customer. No Charge on customer work orders works now."
  • Nothing on the tab is marked as required and no control on it is greyed out because of the hint.

Step 2:

  • The Edit Customer window opens.

Step 3:

  • The checkbox is ticked and "Default internal category" appears under it.

Step 4:

  • The window closes and customer A shows the "Internal" badge.

Step 5:

  • The first hint now reads "Manage categories in Internal Work Orders (Administration > Service). Their expense accounts are set on each category."

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories)

  • S1-R4: “While the toggle is on and no customer carries the flag, the first hint of S1-R3 reads instead "No internal customer yet. Work orders for your own equipment stay billable until you flag one: Edit Customer > Internal customer. No Charge on customer work orders works now." The text is informational; nothing is required and nothing is blocked.”
  • S1-R5: “"Do this later" saves the toggle (on) and closes the modal without flagging anyone; the hint of S1-R4 shows under the toggle until a customer is flagged, as the reminder of what is left to do. No Charge (Story 2) works with no flagged customer. There is no step the user must complete.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Setting on, no customer flagged | "No internal customer yet. Work orders for your own equipment stay billable until you flag one: Edit Customer > Internal customer. No Charge on customer work orders works now." | Hint line under the toggle, persists until a customer is flagged”
